description: Ministry of Provincial Roads Transport Cooperative - Closure of liquidation of the Co-operative Societies with effect from the dates mentioned against each Name of the Co-operative Society
categorisation: This gazette content announces the closure of liquidation for numerous co-operative societies. This is a business/commercial matter involving the formal dissolution and deregistration of commercial entities (co-operative societies), which falls under the Commercial classification (Type 6). It does not involve government structure/personnel, land matters, legal frameworks, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories.
